source_assessment: The first finite nonnegative RAF timestamp establishes its own baseline and feeds zero elapsed time; it no longer subtracts click-time performance.now.

Later equal timestamps feed zero; large positive gaps retain the inherited0.05-second runtime step cap. Nonfinite, wrong-type, negative or reversed current timestamps pause cleanly before runtime.step.
Stopping resets the baseline and increments a walking revision. A stale invalid callback is rejected before clock validation, so it cannot clear a new session's key input or stop its current loop.
Resuming establishes a fresh baseline even when that new timestamp is numerically smaller than the previous session. Old held keys stay cleared.
Focus obtained during draw cancels rescheduling. The end-of-tick revision/active check prevents the interrupted loop from restarting.
Only app.mjs differs from frozen079. Runtime collision, navigation, door controls, exact package/source admission, history lifecycle, six transcripts and vendor files remain byte-identical.
